title: Two Pizzas Cost Him $1 Billion #shorts
description:
In 2010, a programmer paid ten thousand Bitcoin for two pizzas. At Bitcoin's peak, those coins were worth over a billion dollars.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
first_comment: Be honest: would you have kept the coins, or eaten the pizza too? 👇

lines.text: In twenty ten, a programmer paid ten thousand Bitcoin for two pizzas.
Back then, Bitcoin was worth almost nothing.
On May twenty-second, he posted an offer on a forum: pizza for Bitcoin.
A stranger accepted, and ordered two pizzas to his door.
Everyone cheered. Bitcoin had bought something real.
Ten dollars. One hundred. Ten thousand.
At its peak, those same coins were worth over one billion dollars.
The most expensive pizza in history.
He kept paying for pizzas with Bitcoin for months.
Today, that day is celebrated as Bitcoin Pizza Day.
